messages:
Marta (AM): Quick sync — Harpoon POC timeline update. We expect UAT cutover next Wed 4/10. Need owners + blockers. See plan: https://redwood.co/poc/harpoon. @Alex, @Cheng, @Priya please confirm integrations & CRs by EOD Fri.
Alex (SE): Ack. I can own the adapter integration + CR reviews. I have one open MR: !456 (adapter -> service). Planned changes: auth header passthrough, small retry backoff.
Cheng (Eng): Noted. The adapter needs the internal KV endpoint (kv-ux01) opened from staging-subnet. Waiting on network rule. Also depends on the new TLS cert that PKI team scoped last week.
Priya (Eng-Platform): I can take the network rule. I'll open the firewall rule and add a note in the infra ticket. Will target Mon EOD. Ticket: INF-789. I'll also upload the cert once PKI confirms.
Alex (SE): Thanks. For the MR: can someone run the local test harness? dev/run_harpoon.sh spins everything up but needs the KV env var: HARPOON_KV_URL. Quick snippet to run locally:
```
export HARPOON_KV_URL=https://kv-staging.internal:8443
./dev/run_harpoon.sh --env=staging
```
Cheng (Eng): I can send a minimal docker-compose for local dev. Using the harpoon image tag we use in CI. Compose: `docker-compose -f docker/harpoon.yml up --build -d kv-service adapter` I'll DM the file.
Alex (SE): Great. I'll queue CR reviewers: @cheng for infra calls, @marta for acceptance criteria sign-off. Also adding e2e test label: `harpoon/e2e` to the MR.
ops-bot: deploy_scheduler: Deployment to staging scheduled: Thu 2024-04-04 03:00 UTC. (staging.harpoon.redwood) :clock1:
Priya (Eng-Platform): Heads up — I'll add the subnet/NACL change to INF-789 and tag ops. If deploy is Thu 03:00 UTC, I'll aim to have rules in place Wed 23:00 UTC so we have a buffer.
Marta (AM): Nice cadence. Owners summary: Adapter + CR review -> Alex; Network rules + cert -> Priya; Local compose + infra notes -> Cheng. Blockers: PKI cert (PKI-102) and INF-789 network rule. Action items: everyone confirm done or blocked by Mon EOD. :thumbsup:
Alex (SE): I'll post a short PR checklist in the MR and ping reviewers. Will also add regression prompts for the streaming endpoint.
Cheng (Eng): FYI I found a small perf issue when running kv mock — hitting 95th latency on cold start. I'll add a note in the ticket and a quick mitigation (warming call) we can include in the adapter.
Priya (Eng-Platform): I'll coordinate with PKI to expedite PKI-102. If they can't hit Mon, we should consider temp self-signed for UAT (documented).
Marta (AM): OK. If PKI stalls, we fallback to documented self-signed flow but mark it in the runbook. Everyone keep updates here. Thanks — we should be green by Tue for CRs.
Alex (SE): :+1: will aim to merge by Tue 18:00 UTC if no blockers.
ops-bot: reminder: next sync doc updated: https://redwood.co/poc/harpoon/notes (updated by ops-bot)
Marta (AM): Perfect. Ping me if anything slips. End of thread.
